lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a sparse grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments to form grid-like anchor nodes in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge feature is visible across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentration of small, high-frequency luminance points across the anterior cephalic and snout regions.
